title: 第三章 其实是从假面超人开始扮演
slug: 米花大舞台开局扮演工藤新一
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

对了，还有一张蓝色卡没看呢。

【富冈义勇：鬼杀队中的水柱，是一位沉默寡言的剑士，在执行任务时能够冷静的判断形式。】

蓝色卡居然是富冈义勇，一个和死神小学生八竿子打不着的角色。

小黑人点点头：“果然，就应该从工藤新一开始扮演啊。”

“不过我还有个问题哈……这里就是死神小学生的世界，我来扮演工藤新一，那原来的工藤新一怎么办？放转转回收了？”

【本世界原来的人物依然会存在。】

【另外，赠送您一份礼物，今天的报纸。】

一摞报纸突然从空中出现，落进了小黑人的手里。

就在头版头条上，有一张熟悉的大脸。

《高中生名侦探工藤新一再破奇案》

《日本警察的救世主》

那占据了四分之一版幅的黑白照片和每年一棍的经典镜头一模一样。

原来如此，自己身处命运的齿轮刚刚开始转动的时候，很快就要到工藤新一挨那每年一棍的时候了。

但‘快到’毕竟还‘没到’呢，此时此刻确实不是扮演工藤新一的好时间。

系统面板上，最左边的白色卡片又开始出现闪烁的光圈了，系统疯狂暗示中。

“那就决定从这张开始了——扮演！”渚琰·小黑人又指向了那张紫卡，【假面超人】：“虽然皮套不好看，但没有一颗兔头会拒绝成为假面超人！”

毕竟十张卡挨个看了一遍，只有假面超人的战斗力应该是最高的。

随着渚琰指向了【假面超人】角色卡，那张角色卡开始发光，然后如同3D打印一般，一个假面超人从脚开始出现在小黑人的眼前。

与此同时，渚琰突然发现自己同时看见了两个视角，其中一个视角看见了假面超人，另一个视角看到了一个小黑人。

其中能看到假面超人的视角，出现了新的系统面板。

【角色：假面超人】

【扮演者：你才是二百五】

【演出任务·主：击败假面超人的七大劲敌。】

【演出任务·支：打击罪犯，保卫城市平安。】

【演出任务·支：隐藏自己的真实身份。】

【当前扮演度：10%】

“这个扮演度是干嘛的？”

【当扮演者的行为贴近所扮演的角色时，扮演度就会提升。完成支线演出任务会提高扮演度，支线任务失败会减少扮演度。】

【当扮演结束时，扮演度转化为扮演完成度，用于计算积分奖励，同时根据扮演完成度，玩家获得所扮演角色的部分能力。】

【玩家之后扮演其他角色时，可以使用已经获得的角色能力。】

“也就是说将扮演度刷的足够高，就可以鼓捣出一个可以变身假面超人的工藤新一……扮演结束是指完成主线任务吗？”

【完成主线任务，或者所扮演角色死亡都可以视为扮演完成。但如果角色死亡时未完成任务，会固定减少30%扮演度。】

“懂了，未能三星完成关卡。”渚琰·假面超人和渚琰·小黑人异口同声的说道，然后互相观察。

黑手黑脚黑身体，光溜溜的脑袋没有头发，身上有堪比保健室模型的清晰肌肉线条，如同一个祼体但没有第一性征的男人。果然是和犯泽先生一点差别都没有的柯学小黑啊。

相比起假面骑士系列，假面超人的皮套多少有些潦草，细节功夫集中在上半身的铠甲和头盔上，不仅连腰带都没有，下半身只有一条深蓝色大皮裤。

不同的视角、不同结论同时在渚琰的脑袋里翻滚，但条理清晰泾渭分明，因为渚琰现在连大脑也有两个。

渚琰尝试动了动。

两个身体都是渚琰的，意识唯一，一开始控制起来自然有些混乱，两个身体像喝了假酒一样乱扭。

但毕竟每个身体各有一颗大脑，其实也算不上一心二用，在熟练了之后便能让两颗大脑各管各的，互相之间不再干扰。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

By the way, there is still a blue card that I haven’t looked at yet.

[Yiyu Tomioka: Mizuaki in Demon Slayer Corps is a taciturn swordsman who can calmly judge the situation when performing tasks.】

The blue card turned out to be Giyu Tomioka, a character who couldn't compete with the Shinigami elementary school student.

The little black man nodded: "Sure enough, I should start with Kudo Shinichi."

"But I still have a question... This is the world of the Shinigami elementary school student. I will play the role of Kudo Shinichi. What about the original Kudo Shinichi? Has he been released and recycled?"

[The original characters in this world will still exist.】

[Also, a gift for you, today’s newspaper.】

A stack of newspapers suddenly appeared from the air and fell into the hands of the little black man.

Just on the front page, there was a familiar face.

"High School Detective Kudo Shinichi Solves Strange Cases Again and Again"

"The Savior of the Japanese Police"

The black-and-white photo that occupies a quarter of the page is exactly the same as the classic shot every year.

So it turns out that when the gears of fate have just begun to turn, it will soon be the time for Kudo Shinichi to receive that stick every year.

But 'almost' is not 'yet' after all. This moment is indeed not a good time to play Kudo Shinichi.

On the system panel, the white card on the far left began to flash aperture again, indicating that the system was going crazy.

"Then we decided to start with this one - pretending!" Zhuyan Little Black pointed at the purple card again, [Masked Superman]: "Although the leather cover is not good-looking, no rabbit head will refuse to become Masked Superman!"

After all, after reading the ten cards one by one, only Masked Superman should have the highest combat effectiveness.

As Zhuyan pointed to the [Masked Superman] character card, the character card began to glow, and then like a 3D printing, a Masked Superman appeared in front of the little black man's feet.

At the same time, Zhu Yan suddenly found that he saw two perspectives at the same time. One perspective saw the Masked Superman, and the other perspective saw a little black man.

Among them, you can see the perspective of Masked Superman, and a new system panel appears.

[Character: Masked Superman]

[Player: You are the one who is 250]

[Performance mission: Main: Defeat the seven powerful enemies of Masked Superman.】

[Performance mission·Branch: Fight criminals and protect the safety of the city.】

[Performance Task·Branch: Hide your true identity.】

[Current role level: 10%]

"What is this role for?"

[When the actor's behavior is close to the role he plays, the degree of acting will increase.Completing the side performance tasks will increase the performance level, and failing the side tasks will decrease the performance level.】

[When the role-playing is over, the role-playing degree is converted into the role-playing completion degree, which is used to calculate point rewards. At the same time, based on the role-playing completion degree, the player obtains some of the abilities of the role played.】

[Players can use the character abilities they have acquired when playing other characters later.】

"That is to say, if the role-playing degree is raised high enough, you can create a Kudo Shinichi who can transform into Masked Superman...Does the end of the role-playing mean the completion of the main mission?"

[Completing the main mission or the death of the character you played can be regarded as completion of the role.However, if the character dies without completing the task, the performance level will be reduced by 30%.】

"I understand, I couldn't complete the level with three stars." Zhuyan Masked Superman and Zhuyan Little Black Man said in unison, and then looked at each other.

He has black hands, black feet, and a black body. He has a smooth head with no hair, and his body has clear muscle lines comparable to those of a health care model. He looks like a naked man with no primary sexual characteristics.As expected, he is Ke Xue Xiaohei who is no different from Mr. Fang Ze.

Compared to the Kamen Rider series, Kamen Superman's leather case is somewhat sloppy, with the details focused on the armor and helmet on the upper body. Not only does it not even have a belt, the lower body only has a pair of large dark blue leather pants.

Different perspectives and different conclusions were tumbling in Zhuyan's head at the same time, but the logic was clear and distinct, because Zhuyan now even had two brains.

Zhuyan tried to move.

Both bodies belong to Zhu Yan, who has only one consciousness. Naturally, it was a little confusing to control them at first, and the two bodies twisted around like they had drunk fake wine.

But after all, each body has a brain, and it is not really a multitasker. Once you become proficient, you can let the two brains do their own thing without interfering with each other.
